csv_project_name: Design for Ardmore Municipal Airport Construct Runway 13/31
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Ardmore Municipal Airport Construct Runway 13/31. This project aims to provide a full parallel taxiway for Runway 13/31 which is the primary runway at ADM. This will be Phase III of the project and will extend TWY E from TWY B to the NW to connect to the existing section of TWY E. The project will enhance safety and fulfill the recommendation of having a parallel taxiway for runways that have straight-in instrument approaches.
